title: The Radius Valley's Age Evolution Around M Dwarfs: Calibrated Gate, Power Grid, Data, and Code
description: Calibrated statistical gate (1,000 null- plus 1,000 signal-injected Monte Carlo replicates) testing whether current archives can discriminate a literature-sized radius-valley age-evolution effect around M dwarfs from a null effect, plus a 15-cell power grid (500 replicates/cell), frozen checksummed input data, analysis pipeline, publication figures, and an independent audit. Verdict: FAIL (inconclusive); 8x current inventory still only reaches 23.2% literature-sized detection. Manuscript .tex source is withheld until publication; figures, data, code, and results are shared.
